videos.headline: Weber State's Harry makes big interception
videos.description: Bryan Schor attempts a pass to his reciver but Xequille Harry picks him off and returns it 40-yards.

videos.headline: Weber State capitalizes off turnover with rushing TD
videos.description: Kevin Smith takes the pitch and runs it in for a 1-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: James Madison responds with rushing TD
videos.description: Marcus Marshall takes the handoff and runs up the middle, going untouched for a 15-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: James Madison's Stapleton makes unbelievable catch
videos.description: Bryan Schor throws it up to Riley Stapleton and he makes a leaping one-hand grab for a 31-yard gain with a defender all over him.

videos.headline: Cantwell-Smith connection leads to explosive TD
videos.description: Stefan Cantwell delivers a strike to Kevin Smith between two defenders and he races to the endzone for the 81-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Marshall's second TD gives JMU lead
videos.description: Marcus Marshall for the second time sees a gap in the defense and takes off for a 20-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Weber State's Cantwell responds with TD
videos.description: Stefan Cantwell calls his own number and sneaks it in for a 1-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Weber State's Batchelor makes a sensational grab for TD
videos.description: Stefan Cantwell finds Drew Batchelor and he makes a tough catch in traffic for a 36-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: JMU's Schor-Stapleton TD keeps them close
videos.description: Bryan Schor threads the needle to Riley Stapleton for a 40-yard touchdown. This would make the score 28-26 bringing James Madison closer.

videos.headline: Sharp converts the two-point conversion to tie  the game
videos.description: Trai Sharp takes the hand-off and cuts back to score the two-point conversion.

videos.headline: JMU's Ratke nails game-winning field goal
videos.description: Ethan Ratke kicks a 46-yard field goal to beat Weber State in a nail-biter.

videos.headline: Coach  Houston addresses team after win
videos.description: Mike Houston says the Dukes showed great resiliency in the victory against Weber State.
